notes: WArmy 0.4.36 — fix: with "scroll records" (auto-scroll) unchecked, the chat jumped to the very top after the workhorse finished its final reply. Root cause: final-reply delivery triggers several consecutive full chat re-renders (endOfRound -> drainQueue -> loadSessionMessages -> refreshEntityView); each renderChat rebuilds the DOM (innerHTML="") and schedules its own deferred scroll-restore (requestAnimationFrame + setTimeout 140ms). Deferred callbacks from superseded renders held a now-disconnected anchor element, so chatAnchorTop fell back to Number(st.anchorTop)||0 — and anchorTop is always 0 — scrolling the whole chat to the absolute top, even though the synchronous renders had already correctly pinned the reply first content to the viewport top. Fix: chatAnchorTop now preserves the current viewport when the anchor element is lost (never falls back to 0); the scroll target records the reply timestamp, and both the post-grouping restore and the deferred restore re-resolve the reply first content block (.them only) in the current DOM before pinning. Verified with a real-device probe reproducing the actual delivery cascade over long history (before fix scrollTop=0/atTop=true; after fix pinned to reply top maoTop=0, stable across late re-renders; auto-scroll-checked contrast still follows bottom). Changed-area gates passed three consecutive clean rounds. Carries all prior features unchanged.
